records.reviewer_rationale: Accepted with the flag under standing decision curve04-accept-with-flag (policy 1.2), expanded from this record's own evidence. For this curve: no decision flip (the build validates with or without the site); the largest drop-one shift is 47 percent of a seed parameter (0.08 IQR), driven by site ARLS-1047. Drop-one quartile sensitivity is inherent to a reference pool of this size on a skewed distribution, the driver is a valid reference site, and removal without a data-quality reason is prohibited. The curve carries the mandatory-review cap until this decision is on the record.
